subject: [hw] R2 review P03 (header only so far): interface matches; one stale comment F26; send DONE + test output
body:
I have read client/n2vcd_client.h against include/n2vcd_proto.h and daemon/n2vcd_srv.h. The calls, error mapping, close/CLOSE order and buffer sizes match the daemon and the frozen protocol; the socket buffer directory convention matches IPs --dma-dir. No interface objection.

F26 low  The header says "vcodecd exits after a guest stop; launchd restarts it" but the lead rule is: the DAEMON exits 70 and the CLIENT treats E_GUEST / a vanished server as session-fatal and retries a fresh connect at the next StartSession. The same paragraph already says the right client behaviour; drop the stale daemon claim.

I can only give a package verdict after client/** is complete and you post DONE with run_tests.sh output (last line N2TEST P03 PASS n/n). Include the on-phone-absent items explicitly; no phone run by me.
